sloka: ततो राक्षसशार्दूलो विद्राव्य हरिवाहिनीम्।स ददर्श ततो रामं तिष्ठन्तमपारजितम् ।। ६.१००.११ ।।
transliteration: tato rākṣasaśārdūlo vidrāvya harivāhinīm।sa dadarśa tato rāmaṁ tiṣṭhantamapārajitam ।। 6.100.11 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, the tiger among Rakshasas having routed the Vanaras from there, saw the lotus petaleyed Rama, endowed with long arms, an unconquered one, the tamer of enemies, standing with his brother Lakshmana like Lord Vishnu with Indra, holding a huge bow that was scraping the sky.
